title: Frontend Workflow CI facts
description: Authoring/editor schema for the optional flat YAML mapping passed with --ci. Runtime loaders do not enforce this schema. Partial mappings and null (unverified) values are supported; evidence belongs in YAML comments or a referenced durable report. See docs/reference/ci-facts.md.

ci_lint.description: Observed lint result for the recorded revision and evaluation scope. null means unverified; the shipped policy requires the exact string pass.

ci_schema_validation.description: Observed result of the consumer's documented schema/contract checks. null means unverified; the shipped policy requires the exact string pass.

state_coverage_complete.description: Recorded coverage of the required states across the evaluation scope, supported by tests/stories or reviewed evidence. A complete State Matrix alone is insufficient; the shipped policy requires boolean true.

llm_semantic_review.description: The actual semantic review result for the recorded revision and evaluation scope. null means unreviewed. Lint/test success is not this review, and pass is not human approval.
